# cbct_sft_cu128 -- the vision-SFT training env (docs/vision_sft_plan.md §4.5).
# Host conda env, NOT a container: training needs peft/transformers, which the
# vLLM 0.19.0 submission container does not carry.
#
# DO NOT INSTALL gptqmodel HERE. It was installed on 2026-08-14 to load
# Qwen3.5-9B-AWQ for training, and then removed, because it is incompatible
# with this architecture in a way no version pin fixes:
#
#   gptqmodel monkey-patches Triton's autotuner GLOBALLY at import
#   (TritonPatch.apply() in gptqmodel/__init__.py, no opt-out), and Qwen3.5's
#   GatedDeltaNet layers run on fla's Triton kernels, whose CachedAutotuner
#   subclass then dies on a `_cache_lock` that only gptqmodel's patched
#   __init__ sets. Every forward pass hits it.
#
# It is not enough to stop loading an AWQ checkpoint. peft imports gptqmodel
# during get_peft_model -- dispatch_awq() calls is_gptqmodel_awq_layer() for
# every target module -- so merely having it INSTALLED breaks bf16 training
# too. Uninstalling makes peft's is_gptqmodel_available() return False and the
# dispatch short-circuits before the import.
#
# The consequence is the design in code/train/vision_sft.sh: train the adapter on
# models/Qwen3.5-9B (bf16), merge into Qwen3.5-9B-AWQ for deployment. All 142
# tensors the arms target are bit-identical between the two checkpoints, so the
# merge is exact. Serving is vLLM in a container and needs none of this.
#
# optimum, torchao, ninja, PyPcre, TokeNicer, LogBar, Device-SMI, Defuser and
# maturin arrived as gptqmodel dependencies and are harmless leftovers; optimum
# was required by peft only while gptqmodel was present.
#
# numpy stays 2.4.4 -- gptqmodel had pinned it to 2.2.6 exactly, which would
# have downgraded the env; it was installed --no-deps to avoid that.
#
# Regenerate with: pip freeze  (and keep this header)
